text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Haa……haa. 
Ha………… …………

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
……I let it get away. 
The 『Oka Sho』……a once-in-a-lifetime
chance……!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ………………I need to go, right.

The winners would be praised and applauded,
the losers 
would vent their frustration behind the scenes.
This 
is how the once-in-a-lifetime 『Oka Sho』
ended……

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
So then,
once more!
We're starting Kraft-san's victory
celebration! 
……Cheers!

text_block_list.name: Teammates
text_block_list.text: Cheers~!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Wah, wah,
wah! Everyone……! Thank you very much! 
This became a pretty big deal, huh……!?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Everyone from the team's here but…… 
Messiah-san and Heart-san too!
Both of you came too……

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufuu. Well, I lost so I can't 
say I don't have mixed feelings, but――

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
That you won is an irrefutable fact.
Being able to praise 
that which is praiseworthy is just part of
running races.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
That's correct. ……it was a splendid run 
befitting the title of Cherry Blossom
Queen. 
It makes me proud to be your teammate,
Kraft.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Cesario……everyone……!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yeah……yeah, thank you! Me too…… 
it makes me proud to have fought against
such strong rivals!

Kraft.
Not just your rivals……it seems like a 
bunch of others came to congratulate you
though?

Kraft.
Not just your rivals……it seems like a 
bunch of others came to congratulate you
though?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Eh……H-huh!? Everyone, why are you……!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yo! You showed me something intense at the
『Oka Sho』, Kraft! 
You did well to win that hot-blooded
battle!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
You didn't just simply win the race…… 
All of you,
brought that to life. From that run, 
I could feel your strength and iron will.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You're still no match for Sweepy though!
It seems like even 
you can cast some decent magic.
……Not bad at all, Kraft!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Wawawawa……Sweep-san,
and my other senpai…… 
thank you very much!
Um……i-i-it's an honor!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh my……Kraft-san,
there's no need to be so stiff. 
As an Oka Sho Uma Musume,
you could be a bit more dignified.

I guess it's because Sweep Tosho was someone
she already 
looked up to. On top of that,
Air Groove and Hishi Amazon――

I guess it's because Sweep Tosho was someone
she already 
looked up to. On top of that,
Air Groove and Hishi Amazon――

I think it's natural that she'd be like that
when 
she's surrounded by so many 『Queen Uma
Musume』

Queen Uma Musume……in other words,
『The Strongest Senior Class Uma 
Musume』,
a URA title reserved for the best and
brightest.

For Rhein Kraft and the others in the Triple
Tiara rotation, these 
Uma Musume could almost be called an existence
above the clouds――

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Even then,
those impressive senpai came all 
the way here.
That's just how impressive the 
race that Kraft-san showed them was,
you know?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ――Really, it's something to be proud of.

True.
After defeating such strong Uma Musume 
like Cesario, Daring Heart,
and Air Messiah, 
Rhein Kraft could almost be seen as a
hero.

It seems like that impression was already
spreading through 
Tracen Academy,
with many Uma Musume coming to the after
party――

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Oh man,
we're late……!
This is because you kept worrying 
『My hair just doesn't look right~』, you know,
Scarlet!?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Even you kept saying 『These clothes won't
work~』 
the whole time,
didn't you!? You're no different from me!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah……Vodka-san and Scarlet-san! 
Both of you came too?

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Kraft! You were amazing, congratulations!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh-……! As usual,
both of you are in synch~.

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: No we're not!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Forget that……well. It really was amazing,
Kraft. 
……it makes us think we need to do that too,
we 
need to show that we can do that too.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Your run was really exciting!
When we got back to the 
academy after that we ended up running like
crazy!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Next it's us, we need to do that too. 
……Seriously, it was really cool, Kraft!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
……! 
Cool――

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Fufuu……Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
You've got a silly look on your face,
don't you? 
I'm glad you're having fun though.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah……yeah, the party's fun,
and I'm happy. ……and besides that, 
I wonder if I was able to do what I wanted
to!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
What you wanted to?……You mean becoming
someone like our 
senpais? 『Someone that everyone looks up to』,
becoming 
a link for the girls that come next,
that talk?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
I really want to be able to fulfill that. 
If it's the 『Oaks』 then……to become an
ideal for so many girls,
just like Air Groove-san!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I want to show them how much stronger I can
be too. 
……I won't lose to you at the 『Oaks』 either,
Cesario!

Despite the growing number of participants,
the party 
continued on. Of course, I also joined,
wholeheartedly 
celebrating Rhein Kraft's victory,
however――

(I couldn't really talk to her……because I
had something weighing on my mind.
When I saw her 
celebrating,
I couldn't help but feel sorry……)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Yes? Did you need something?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fuu, ahahaa! Was it that surprising? 
……Or,
is it 『Because it's me』 that you're so
surprised?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
……in regards to the 『Oka Sho』 results. 
Is there something bothering you, Trainer?

(Cesario seems to have already noticed…… 
there was no point in hiding it.)

(Cesario seems to have already noticed…… 
there was no point in hiding it.)

I told her everything.
That before the 『Oka Sho』 I had given
Rhein Kraft advice.
……and the advice that I hadn't given to
Cesario.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
……I see. In that case,
if you had given me that advice……for
example, 
『Match Kraft and accelerate early』,
if you had said that――

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Would it have been enough to guarantee 
that I would win the 『Oka Sho』?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Right. That's just how races are. 
Nobody knows what the results will be 『If
only』

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
……truly,
I don't think it's possible to know. If I 
had accelerated earlier,
considering how she held on, 
I'm not sure I could have passed
her……honestly.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ――Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I believe saying any more than that……about
our earnest 
run, the results that Kraft achieved,
about me……and 
above all else, to you yourself as a trainer,
is rude.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
『To run in a way that befits me』.
……I believe 
that was the best course of action for the
Oka Sho. As a trainer,
I believe you acted correctly.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Any more than this―― 
and I'll have to ask you to stop disparaging
my trainer.

I was about to apologize again,
but I stopped myself.
Cesario had a satisfied smile on her face 
as she looked up to the stars――and then
said――

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I think……together with Kraft,
I can't help 
but wonder what kind of wonderful future
awaits us.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Just by watching her,
I think it will link 
to the future……I will be the one to guide
the girls that start running for that same
reason.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
With my dream,
and those girls' dreams.
By combining those two, 
I wonder……if it will lead to a never seen
before scene.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, sorry,
for suddenly bringing this up. 
……But, strangely, that's how I feel.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
However, for that reason,
I can't stay as I am. 
I can't guide them if I don't shine.
To become that guiding light,
I must earn that crown.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
……the 『Oaks』 is the only race in the Tiara
rotation that matches 
the classic races in distance. To win,
it requires strength.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
As its name suggests, similar to an Oak,
it has a solid, unwavering,
overwhelming strength. 
……At the 『Oaks』 I will prove I have that
strength.

……Yeah.
We should stop worrying over the 『Oka Sho』.
Next time 
……I'll continue to work to properly support
both of you!

I returned back to my room to look over my
documents again. 
Next up is the second battle of the Triple
Tiara that Rhein 
Kraft and Cesario will be running in,
the 『Oaks』

……As I thought.
Looking at past records……with any
distance 
above 2000m,
Kraft is rarely able to defeat Cesario……
……An issue of 『Distance Aptitude』, huh――
